text:
Maria: heads up — ran a canary for AWQ int8 with mixed group sizes and saw tail latency jump ~9% on p99 for chat workloads this morning 
Sam: ugh, which config? group-size distribution or packing change?
Maria: non-uniform group packing enabled (auto-pack heuristics), sampler calibration left default. The regression appears only when group sizes vary inside a batch rather than uniform groups.
Jon: do you have a short perf log? rough numbers are fine.
Maria: here — baseline (uniform g=128): p50 18ms p95 42ms p99 120ms. with non-uniform pack: p50 20ms p95 45ms p99 131ms. also CPU steal spikes during pack/unpack.
Kyle: sounds like packing overhead + KV cache churn. when groups are non-uniform the packer misaligns slabs and we do extra memcpy + re-allocs.
Sam: can you paste the profiler hot functions?
Maria: profiler snippet:```hot functions sorted by self time
0. pack_and_align() 32.4%
1. kv_prefetch_sync() 18.1%
2. unpack_fastpath() 12.7%
3. attention_kv_cache_hotpath() 9.5%
```
Jon: kv_prefetch_sync at 18% is surprising — prefetch usually small. Maybe sampler calibration increased prefetch breadth.
Maria: yeah sampler switched from conservative->aggressive after the last calib commit (cc @perfbot who applied it).
perfbot: calibration change ID 4f2a applied yesterday (sampler: target_coverage=0.92 -> 0.98). I flagged tests but no regression alert yet.
Kyle: increasing coverage reduces misses but can cause more prefetch work and contention. In mixed group sizes that extra prefetch gets duplicated per-subgroup and kills latency.
Sam: experiment suggestion: revert sampler target_coverage to 0.92 for the canary and re-run same request mix. If p99 drops back it's the sampler.
Maria: already did — reverting to 0.92 restored p99 to 121ms (within noise). Will run a narrow A/B (50/50) across nodes now.
Jon: we should also try a packing-locality optimization: prefer stable slab alignment for trailing small groups (pad instead of repack) and measure cost/quality tradeoffs.
Kyle: agree. two quick PRs: 1) sampler throttle when micro-batch has >1 group-size variant; 2) packer pad-small-groups flag to prefer alignment over density.
Sam: also add a telemetry tag for nonuniform_group=true so we can correlate with KV eviction rates.
Maria: flagged in issue tracker and starting canary with sampler revert + packer pad enabled on 4 nodes. will post results in 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jon: thanks — if we see p99 improvement, let's roll a canary rollback for the calibration change and iterate on the packer patch.
Maria: noted. will include a flamegraph and slab-metrics in follow-up.
Kyle: small note — check SIGOPS alerting thresholds, the noisy CPU steal could be cloud scheduling affecting pack microbench. try pinned instances for reproducibility.
Maria: good call, switching to pinned tonight for the final run.
Sam: sweet. if this reproduces locally we can add a microbench that simulates non-uniform group distributions and run in CI.
Maria: yep planning that. thanks all :pray:
